coupling: The RegExpShared shrink commit adds a uint32_t hasQuickCheckChars overload that accepts any nonempty suffix. The quickcheck commit adds a uint64_t overload that requires a full four-byte mask and passes a uint32_t remaining length before a four-byte read. With both edits, overload resolution selects the one-character guard and the read crosses a string allocation boundary. The first edit alone has no caller; the second alone selects the four-byte guard.
